verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has a built-in LLM chat window that can be linked to sessions for context-aware help. It can explain output with annotations and run commands on your behalf, which covers explaining and fixing failed commands on request. It requires installing an optional generative-AI plugin, and nothing shows it detecting or responding to command failures on its own. Missing for 10: automatic failure-triggered explanations or fix suggestions, in-depth first-party docs on the error-explanation workflow, independent hands-on corroboration of fix quality.
